method: Resolve file mod declarations from lib.rs (including #[path]); scan crate:: and server:: paths and grouped imports; source #[test] inventory, including existing ignored tests. Macro-generated and dynamic edges are not inferred. One schedules/mod.rs match is inside a macro template, not a file. Inbound excludes test/fixture-named files, but may include inline tests. External namespace names are filtered against actual server modules. Confirm finalists manually before moving.
